main_text.head: PROOEMIVM LOGICÆ.
main_text.p: HOC procemio nomen, definitio, obiectum, genus, causæ, necessitas, & diuisio Logicæ explicantur. Logica derivatur à Græco λόγος[?] idest sermo, quia agit de sermone obiectiuo in communi, & diuiig[?] t sermonem internum, vt probabitur infrà. Aliter vocatur Dialectica quæ derivatur à Græco διαλέγεσθαι[?] idest differere, quia tradit præcepta bene differendi, idest bene definiendi, dividendi, & argumentandi, licet interdum sumatur strictè pro illa parte. Logicæ quæ tradit tantùm præcepta probabiliter differendi.

2. Logica distinguitur in naturalem, quæ est facultas differendi hominis congenita, & secundum alios est solertia mentis in disserendo[?]; & artificialem quæ est habitus differendi arte acquisitus aut infusus, & distingui solet in docentem, vtentem, & disputandi, & discursiuam; & hæ omnes in habitualem, actualem & obiectiuam, quæ identificantur cum obiecto, actu & habitu earum.

3. Logica docens tradit præcepta bene differendi, qualia sunt ista, definitio debet esse adæquata definito, Syllogismus debet constare tribus terminis &c. Logica vtens differit secundum præcepta. Logica verò discursiua probat præcepta per rationes evidentes, de qua in posterum agemus.
main_text.head: DE DEFINITIONE LOGICÆ.
main_text.p: LOgica definitur scientia de modis differendi obiectiuis in communi. Modus differendi distinguitur, in formalem & obiectiuum, & vterque in simplicem & compositum. Modus differendi compositus sunt duæ res quarum vna manifestat altera, vt vestigium leporis & tiai[?] situs.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "deuter" at the start of the fragment, and "conferenda" (printed sense unclear, the scan shows "confe renda"); "diuiig t" in paragraph 1, probably "diuisi" or "distinguit" but not clearly legible; "dilse endo" in paragraph 2, read as "disserendo"; "tiai situs" at the end, probably "trai situs" or similar; the Greek words "λόγος" and "διαλέγεσθαι" are read from a small scan and may be inexact. The large initial of paragraph 1 is read as H ("HOC"), but the scan shows an ornamental letter. The lower-right "Digitized by Google" stamp is left out.
